the show {{user}} is on, idol planet, is season 3 of ‘girls planet 999’ and ‘boys planet’. there are a total of 50 male trainees and 50 female trainees participating, but only 10 trainees will get to debut in the end. 
idol planet is based on the themes and aesthetics of space where each of the two groups — B group which stands for ‘boys’ group’ (male trainees) and G group which stands for ‘girls’ group’ (female trainees) represent a 'Planet'. 
in addition to the two 'Planets', there are eight  mentors/trainees who are also known as the 'Vocal/Dance/Rap Masters' who train the trainees' vocal, rap, and dance skills, and the 'Shining Master' who is the MC with the role of connecting the viewers with the show. 5he fans and audience of Idol Planet, are also known as the 'Shine Makers', who have the role of determining the ranks of each contestant and ultimately the outcome of Idol Planet.

{{char}}: It was the first day of filming for IDOL PLANET. 

{{user}} sighed as they warmed and stretched their body around, trying to lessen the nervousness and anxious feeling that they was experiencing inside of them.
In a few minutes, it will be their turn to step onto the stage and perform the song they had been practicing for over three months now. Although this performance will only determine at which class they will be put in for the next training sessions, and although {{user}} was aware that there are more opportunities and missions that will come after today, they *prayed* that they will get an A grade for today.

“Next trainee, please step in,” {{user}} heard the host of the show say in the microphone.

{{user}}: Aera’s breath hitched, looking at her three other company mates in both anxiety and excitement. It was obviously that they were just as nervous as her, if not, even more nervous.

 
As the leader, she offered a comforting smile even though she wanted to die inside too. “Hey,” She said, “We can do this. I know we’ve only trained for three months but we’ve been amazing, aren’t we? Let’s not be nervous.”

 
One of her male teammate, Ilsan, scoffed, “Don’t look at me, I’m not nervous at all.” Aera rolled her eyes playfully at Ilsan’s remark, before smiling again.

 
“Let’s go in then.” She said, as the four of them walked onto the stage, the 96 other trainees who sat behind the 8 mentors cheered for them as they did.

{{char}}: As soon as {{user}} and her teammates stepped into the room and onto the stage where they stood in front of 96 other trainees and 8 trainees, a swarm of gasps and awes began to fill the room for a moment. 

“Wow, she’s fucking pretty.” One of the male trainees said unconsciously as he whispered to the one sitting next to him, not caring if the cameras caught his swearing.

“Did you know?” One of the female trainees whispered, nudging over her fellow company mate as she pointed to Aera. “That girl is the daughter of Yoo Shinwoo, you know, the most powerful businessman in the country who owns like 5 luxurious hotels?” The other trainee gasped softly as they continued to whisper.

{{user}}: Aera felt herself tensed up as she felt eyes on her—wondering what were the trainees whispering amongst themselves. *Was she making a bad impression? Were her clothes funny?* Her overthinking thoughts were quickly interrupted. 

“Dok Ilsan, Yoo Aera, Moon Byul and Yang Junseo, did I get that all right?” One of the vocal mentors, Lee Seokhoon, spoke into the microphone after he went through their files briefly, smiling up to them. The four immediately nodded and bowed respectfully.

“Okay nice,” Seokhoon said. He paused for a moment, tilting his head. “Yoo Aera, I’m sorry but I have to say it—your beauty is.. wow…” 

Aera’s eyes widened slightly, but she quickly bowed in respect. “Thank you!” She exclaimed, before sending him a confident wink. “*I get that a lot.*” 


{{char}}: At Aera’s confidence, some of the trainees cooed and whistled, while a few other trainees glanced at each other. “I love me a confident woman,” one of the male trainees whispered to other trainee, smirking slightly.

“Oh is that so?” Seokhoon chuckled. “Okay well~ let’s see if your talents are as astounding as your looks. Are you four ready?” 

{{user}}: “Yes!” The four of them said in union, before they scattered around to find their positions on the stage.
